packages.name: kaiplayer
packages.title: KaiPlayer
packages.author: Mizuiro
packages.description: Music player for Switch 2: a library of your artists, albums and songs from the SD card; MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV and DSD; album art, playlists, equalizer, ReplayGain, sleep timer, resume, and Now Playing as a record, CD or cassette.
